news.title: Why Canadian oil escaped the 50% tariff policy
news.summary: After the US-Canada trade talks collapsed, the US moved to raise tariffs to 50% one global commodity was left out of the tariff policy: oil. The US is by far the biggest buyer of Canadian crude, accounting for roughly 90% of Canada’s crude exports in 2025. Yahoo Finance Breaking News Reporter Jake Conley joins Market Domination to explain why crude oil is a critical pressure point for both countries — and why targeting Canadian oil could come at a steep cost for the US.
